name: Universal Car Phone Mount with Dashboard Adhesive
description: This universal phone mount attaches securely to any dashboard using a high-strength adhesive pad. Its 360-degree swivel arm lets you position your device for optimal viewing while driving. Made from ABS plastic, it resists heat and UV exposure for long-lasting performance.
